claims.text: Open-weight coding model Oct 21 (announce + HF weights 14:20:58Z, 733 likes): 39.8B total/2.5B active MoE, 49 layers (2 dense + 47 MoE), 256 routed experts 6/token + shared, SWA-513, vocab 150144, cutoff June 2026; Eureka Machine searched recipes + 4-bit lm_head quantization; train from scratch.
claims.context: Official article 366583B + HF card 6250B; card Apache-2.0

claims.text: Capability: supports up to 512K tokens; recommends staying within 256K. Config 262144 (prompt+output) is NOT publisher max — conflation prohibited. Speed vendor-claimed: 125+ tok/s M4 Pro MacBook Pro, 150+ 64GB RTX Spark short contexts; avg throughout 128K session (*Muse 124K, prefill excluded); up to 2x faster than comparables.

Apache-2.0 weights; hosted API terms separate; WIRED Oct 21 hands-on corroborates same-day; Grok Flint+M4 Pro chatter (no post IDs) corroboration only; Term-Bench 2.1 54.9 / SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7 / Verified 74.2 (Terminus2/mini-swe-agent, temp1.0/top-p0.95/top-k20, avg pass@1 5+ attempts, web-retrieval-as-failure).
claims.context: Card license + eval sections; WIRED; Grok topic mention
